recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14865 unless the work group separately changes the later FHIR-29968 Extensible-binding policy.
issue_request: FHIR-14865 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked the FHIR-core terminologies page to clarify that extensible bindings allow second-level or other hierarchical codes when the desired meaning is not present in the specified value set.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies GH#5f9b6eca5d, and commit 5f9b6eca5d changed source/terminologies.html and source/terminologies-binding-examples.html to separate the no-applicable-concept case from the more-general-concept-present case, add explicit is-a hierarchy language, and add Condition examples for both valid and invalid outside-code use.
additional_context: Same-day FHIR-17284 clarified nearby alternate concept/text wording and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-29968 reorganized the Extensible Binding Strength guidance for R5 and is already reconciled on the combined branch; its minutes preserve the same scenarios relevant to FHIR-14865. FHIR-48479 later restructured the binding-strength table but left the detailed FHIR-14865 guidance and examples intact.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/terminologies.html still says an alternate concept may have any specificity in an is-a hierarchy when no applicable value-set concept exists, and still requires the closest more general value-set concept when one applies while allowing a more specific outside code as an additional CodeableConcept Coding. Current source/terminologies-binding-examples.html still demonstrates the hierarchy cases.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 issue requesting clearer Extensible-binding documentation and examples for second-level hierarchical codes.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final WG intent to allow an outside hierarchical code only when the desired meaning is not present in the bound value set.

evidence_items.summary: The original GF#14865 commit changed source/terminologies.html and source/terminologies-binding-examples.html to add hierarchy guidance and examples.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was explicitly applied in source, not merely resolved in Jira.

evidence_items.summary: The current Extensible section allows an alternate concept, including code or text, and says the alternate concept can have any level of specificity in an is-a hierarchy when no applicable value-set concept exists.
evidence_items.learned: The current narrative still contains the central FHIR-14865 clarification.

evidence_items.summary: The current narrative and Condition examples show that a more general value-set concept must be used when it applies, while a more specific outside code may accompany it as an additional Coding.
evidence_items.learned: The examples preserve the accepted boundary around second-level code use and prevent over-reading Extensible as unrestricted replacement.
